features.name: Flower Catalog Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse available flowers with images, descriptions, and prices.
user_stories: As a customer, I can browse flower categories so that I can find the perfect arrangement for my needs.
As a customer, I can view detailed flower information so that I can make an informed purchase decision.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the catalog page, When I select a category, Then I see all flowers in that category with images and prices.
Given I click on a flower, When the detail page loads, Then I see description, price, availability, and customer reviews.

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Customers can add flowers to cart, modify quantities, and proceed to checkout.
user_stories: As a customer, I can add flowers to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items at once.
As a customer, I can modify cart contents so that I can adjust my order before checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a flower, When I click add to cart, Then the item appears in my cart with correct quantity and price.
Given I have items in cart, When I change quantity or remove items, Then the cart total updates immediately.

features.name: Order Placement and Payment
features.description: Customers can complete checkout with delivery details and payment processing.
user_stories: As a customer, I can enter delivery information so that flowers are sent to the correct address.
As a customer, I can pay securely online so that I can complete my flower order.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am at checkout, When I enter valid delivery details, Then the system validates and saves the address.
Given I submit payment, When payment is processed successfully, Then I receive an order confirmation with tracking number.

features.name: Order Tracking
features.description: Customers can track their flower delivery status in real-time.
user_stories: As a customer, I can view my order status so that I know when my flowers will arrive.
As a customer, I can receive delivery notifications so that I am informed of order progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have placed an order, When I check order status, Then I see current delivery stage and estimated arrival time.
Given my order status changes, When an update occurs, Then I receive an email or SMS notification.

features.name: Admin Inventory Management
features.description: Administrators can manage flower inventory, pricing, and availability.
user_stories: As an admin, I can add new flowers to the catalog so that customers have more options.
As an admin, I can update inventory levels so that the system reflects current stock availability.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as admin, When I add a new flower with details, Then it appears in the customer catalog immediately.
Given I update stock quantity, When inventory reaches zero, Then the flower is marked as out of stock on the website.
